# `flate` standard library

The `flate` module provides pure Edva implementations of RFC 1951 (DEFLATE),
RFC 1950 (Zlib), and RFC 1952 (Gzip) lossless compression and decompression.
The decompressor handles stored blocks (`BTYPE=00`), fixed-Huffman blocks
(`BTYPE=01`), and dynamic-Huffman blocks (`BTYPE=10`), while the compressor
uses a 32 KiB LZ77 sliding-window hash matcher paired with canonical
fixed-Huffman encoding.

```{.dva .run}
#use flate
#use io
#use str

msg = "Hello Edva DEFLATE! Hello Edva DEFLATE! Hello Edva DEFLATE!"
z = flate::zlib_compress(msg)
io::out $ "compressed bytes: " + str::from_int(?z)
io::out $ (flate::zlib_decompress(z) | s => s | "")
```

## Function catalog

| Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `flate::deflate_raw(data)` | `String => String` | Compresses `data` into a raw RFC 1951 DEFLATE bitstream |
| `flate::inflate_raw(data)` | `String => < String | Error >` | Decompresses a raw RFC 1951 DEFLATE bitstream (`BTYPE=00/01/10`) |
| `flate::zlib_compress(data)` | `String => String` | Compresses `data` into an RFC 1950 Zlib stream (header + DEFLATE + Adler-32) |
| `flate::zlib_decompress(data)` | `String => < String | Error >` | Decompresses an RFC 1950 Zlib stream and verifies its Adler-32 trailer |
| `flate::gzip_compress(data)` | `String => String` | Compresses `data` into an RFC 1952 Gzip stream (10B header + DEFLATE + CRC-32 + ISIZE) |
| `flate::gzip_decompress(data)` | `String => < String | Error >` | Decompresses an RFC 1952 Gzip stream and verifies its CRC-32 and ISIZE trailers |
